items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: We first cousins. ... And Percy, I don't know, he was playing drums too, I heard. ... So I had never heard him, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's over in Virginia now, plays bass. Oh, do he? Plays bass.
Yeah, I know he was playing trombone at the time. Yeah, he did for many years. And Percy, I don't know, he was playing drums too, I heard.
Yeah, Percy started on drums. Drums, yeah.
